decisions.reason: As a multi-model waterproof line close to the core offer and publicly launched as part of the firm's innovation narrative, the sunk development and tooling investment and the visible commitment favor persisting with it, especially since the missing web data for 2020–2021 points to no clear failure and any weakness can be blamed on pandemic disruption.

This single ESD occupational shoe fits the firm's established protective-footwear direction and serves a stable industrial niche, so management would attribute any soft results to temporary pandemic effects and keep it, though as a single model it is somewhat easier to drop than a full line.

The safety shoe series is a multi-model line central to the firm's core business and announced strategy, so the substantial investment and public commitment make management likely to persist with it rather than drop it within the coming year.
